messages:
Maya: Hey team — spontaneous idea for Saturday: short forest walk in the morning, then come over for a wood-fired pizza potluck at my place in the afternoon? :evergreen_tree: :pizza:
Noah: omg yes. what time for the walk?
Maya: thinking 9:30am at the trailhead (Maple Ridge). then pizzas around 3pm. bring toppings/whatever you want on pizza.
Sofia: I can bring a batch of pesto and some toppings. also bringing my old pizza peel if you need it. :raised_hands:
Elliot: count me in. will bring dough (or pre-baked bases if you prefer) and a small bluetooth speaker.
Priya: would love to come but have a kiddo soccer match at 11am — might join after the game? maybe show up for pizza around 4:30?
Maya: totally fine, Priya — swing by whenever. more pizza = better.
Noah: is the spot kid/pet friendly? thinking of bringing Luna (dog).
Maya: yes small well-behaved dogs ok, and there's a picnic area. just keep on-leash.
Elliot: dietary callouts? I can do a vegan cheese for one pie.
Sofia: perfect. I’ll mark one pizza vegetarian too.
Priya: I'll bring a little fruit salad and a thermos of coffee for afterwards.
Noah: do we need plates/cups/napkins or should I grab disposables?
Maya: I have some plates but bring extra napkins and cups if you can.
OpsBot: Reminder: Maya's potluck — Saturday 15:00 local. Reply "going" to RSVP.
Sofia: going :thumbsup:
Noah: going (Luna in tow)
Elliot: going
Priya: maybe (soccer)
Maya: Awesome. if anyone needs address or directions DM me. cheers! :party_popper:
